i.new_string:
## Running the end-to-end tests

The e2e suite uses [Playwright](https://playwright.dev) and lives in `e2e/specs`.

1. Install browsers once: `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`.
2. Start the backing services: `npm run e2e:stack` (Docker Compose, waits until healthy).
3. Run the suite: `npm run e2e`. Playwright starts the Vite dev server on port 5173 for you, or reuses one you already have running.
4. To debug a single spec interactively: `npm run e2e:ui`.

Set `E2E_BASE_URL` to point the tests at another server. Locally there are no retries; in CI each test retries twice and records a trace on the first retry, which you can open with `npx playwright show-trace`.
